scenarios.expected: Only the intended published audience reaches the item and its files; later removal takes effect. Direct links do not bypass publication/audience checks, including links to supporting Documents.
scenarios.actual: While Draft and while published Legal Only, both Portal readers (Jonas Weber and Amara Nwosu) were redirected to the Portal home and the article API answered 404 (4 denied reads); Publish removed the Draft marker without showing On the portal; the Contributor Ravi Menon could not open the staff record. Audience Everyone on the published item showed the On the portal marker and saved audience=everyone. Settings / Intake / Deflection links offered Add link with Target, Label and Placement exactly as the corrected guide names them; Daniel Okafor in a separate Administrator context added a Knowledge item link placed on the Portal home. Jonas Weber reached the article from Before you submit, read its title and guidance heading, and downloaded both Documents with bytes equal to the uploaded PDF and DOCX; the Documents region sat above Guidance and the primary was listed first; no staff actions were offered. Amara Nwosu and the Contributor Ravi Menon reached the same published Everyone article. The dialog named 1 deflection link; Cancel left Audience on Everyone and Continue saved Legal Only. The On the portal marker went, the link disappeared from Before you submit, and the saved article address plus both saved Document download addresses answered 404 for both Portal readers (6 denied reads). The deflection link row was still in Settings. Unpublish asked the same portal question, returned the item to Draft and kept Audience Everyone; while draft the article and both file addresses answered 404 (6 denied reads); Publish alone brought back the existing deflection link, the article and both downloads. Archive with Rev C34 legal_team_member 2459EE replacement pack under Replaced by marked the item Archived, disabled Title and Audience and removed Upload, while the article, both file addresses and the Before you submit link went (6 denied reads). The saved staff address still opened the archived record with its Documents listed and offered Restore; restoring returned published/Everyone with both Documents and the recorded replacement, and the Portal article, both downloads and the deflection link all worked again. With the item archived and Rev C34 legal_team_member 2459EE replacement pack named as its replacement, the old Portal address returned the reader to the Portal home rather than to the replacement, and the unpublished replacement itself answered 404; the item was restored afterwards. A browser with no session was sent to the Portal sign-in page for the published Everyone item, and its direct article request answered 401.
scenarios.stepsSummarized: 9 recorded steps for this role; the linked record holds each one separately

scenarios.expected: A Portal reader reaches a published Everyone item and its files, and nothing else.
scenarios.actual: Jonas Weber and Amara Nwosu each signed in to the Business Portal from their own magic link in this lab. While the item was Draft, published Legal Only, unpublished or archived, both were returned to the Portal home and the article and both saved Document download addresses answered 404. While it was published for Everyone, Jonas followed the Before you submit link, read the title and guidance, downloaded the primary PDF and the supporting DOCX with bytes equal to the uploaded files, and was offered no staff controls; Amara reached the same article and downloaded the supporting Document. Both publisher runs were observed from these two Portal contexts.
scenarios.stepsSummarized: The Portal reader outcomes recorded inside the 18 publisher steps of the linked record

scenarios.expected: Both guides are reachable from their Help contexts and the formal reader, and stay usable with the keyboard, in three themes, in narrow layouts and at 200 percent zoom.
scenarios.actual: Help on /knowledge offered "Create and organize Knowledge Items" (Publish Knowledge for the right audience listed 0 times there) and Help on a Knowledge record offered both guides, matching their knowledge.list, knowledge.overview and knowledge.publishing contexts. Searching the exact title opened create-knowledge with its h1 focused; the outline links for Before you start, Start with files, Start with guidance each focused their heading; the formal link reached /documentation/create-knowledge. Searching the exact title opened publish-knowledge with its h1 focused; the outline links for Before you start, Publish and check the Portal, Withdraw or restrict an item each focused their heading; the formal link reached /documentation/publish-knowledge. Both guides were read in light, dark and warm themes at 320, 720 and 1440 CSS pixels and at emulated 200 percent zoom with no horizontal overflow in any of the 20 combinations. Tabbing from the top of the Help panel reached the "Publish Knowledge for the right audience" link and Enter opened it, leaving focus on the article heading. Searching Help for the fictional Knowledge Item title "Rev discovery 9BB976 fictional pack" answered No matching articles, so product Help did not reach the organization’s Knowledge, exactly as create-knowledge says.
scenarios.stepsSummarized: 6 recorded steps for this role; the linked record holds each one separately

scenarios.expected: A guidance edit and a new Document Version on an already published Everyone item reach a separate Business Portal reader on reload with no second Publish action, while the earlier Version stays on the staff chain and the publication state does not change.
scenarios.actual: Audience Everyone and Publish put the item on the portal; Jonas Weber read its first guidance heading and downloaded the current Version, whose bytes matched the uploaded PDF. With no second Publish, the reloaded Portal article showed the edited guidance heading and its download returned the new current Version byte for byte; the staff chain still held Version 1 beside the current Version 2, and state, audience and the first publication stamp were unchanged (published/everyone).
scenarios.stepsSummarized: 2 supplemental steps for this role; the linked record holds each one separately
